about_the_game:
In Fawe, you are an adventurer exploring a continent devastated by the Destruction of the Gods, a catastrophic event filled with plagues and cursed creatures. You begin the game in Finraza, helping the last inhabitants of Akkadian Village, who need all the help they can get to survive. Face monsters, gather resources, recover artifacts, and forge your path to glory!

Customize your character by choosing their color, hairstyle, and skin tone. Choose from a selection of initial outfits and begin your adventure! You can also form groups with your friends and play alongside them, defeating stronger monsters you couldn't defeat alone, and sharing the experience with them.

Currently, the game has 4 classes, available at level 8, each with 3 skills. There are also 20 monsters and 6 maps, with over 150 items and equipment available, and around 80 quests. It also has 6 mounts, each with a different bonus. The town has a blacksmith who can forge and enchant equipment.
